title: APIM migration journal
description: What a migration run actually did. The plan is intent; this is history, so a failed run resumes instead of restarting.

source.description: The APIM instance this came from. Never written to: migration is additive.

acknowledged.description: Manual prerequisites an operator has confirmed are done.

rehearsals.description: When each phase was last rehearsed. A rehearsal makes no history, so it records only that it happened.

status.description: unverified means the write succeeded and this tool has no way to read it back -- different from mutationUnknown, where the write was accepted but its outcome could not be established. Only the latter is never blindly retried.

argv.description: The command as run, with any @file argument redacted.
